_doc: The one list of analytics events on invoicesnap.work (NIK-634, 12 Nov 2026). tests/test_events.py fails when the code sends an event that is not here, or this list names a sent event the code no longer sends. GA4 property 516575048 (G-X4TCVJMVEP); PostHog US project shared with the app. All load only after consent: src/static/assets/ga.js. Never put a form value in a property.

tool_used.where: ga.js trackToolUsed; called by tool.js (first edit, add row, download) and the homepage calculator (src/pages/index.html)

tool_download.where: tool.js dl(): every PDF, Word and Excel download, also the blank form

preview_pdf_modal.where: src/pages/index.html, the Preview Sample Invoice button

click_web_app.where: ga.js, any link to app.invoicesnap.work on any page

click_app_store.where: ga.js, any link to apps.apple.com on any page

click_outbound.where: ga.js, any link to another domain (not the app, not the App Store)

scroll_depth.where: ga.js, 25 / 50 / 75 / 90 % of the page, once each per page view

web_vital.where: ga.js with assets/web-vitals.iife.js: LCP, INP, CLS (x1000), FCP, TTFB of real visits
